task: Make _served_prompt in cli_analytics_handler.py ignore session_title for Desktop-hosted entrypoints, threading entrypoint through 3 handler call sites and 3 reader.py queries.

key_reasoning.reason: Several design decisions are explicitly open per technical-analysis.md: the three Desktop entrypoint literals (claude-desktop, claude-desktop-3p, local-agent) are unverified against any committed source and come only from a prior out-of-band investigation of live data; there is no existing enum/constant to centralize them in, so where to place the new literals is an unmade decision; and the empty/blank-entrypoint case for _served_prompt is explicitly flagged as undecided in the TESTS-expected section.

Confined to exactly two files/components: cli_analytics_handler.py (_served_prompt plus its 3 callers — _session_row, get_session_detail, get_efficiency — plus named_first_prompt) and reader.py (3 queries, 2 of them coupled: _sessions_cte and get_session_cost_facts). Only 2 layers touched (Service, DB-Persistence/Repository), and the pure-function/coalesce-idiom pattern is already established in both files.

Service layer (handler) and DB-Persistence layer (postgres reader) are both touched via an established interface (reader rows feeding handler pure functions); no schema migration, no REST/OpenAPI response model change, no new feature flag.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from M to L: unverified Desktop entrypoint literal values, no existing constant/enum to centralize them in, and an undecided empty-entrypoint case are all open design decisions per technical-analysis.md's Risk Indicators section.
